THE SHUBHAM K MART GUIDELINES09 / 20
09
RELEVANT. HONEST. UNCLUTTERED.

Make the message
the main thing.

Use authorized product images and purposeful illustrations. Every visual should help someone understand the category or message.

A PURPOSEFUL COMPOSITION

One focal point.
Room for the story.

Abstract shapes shown as editorial illustration. Use approved catalogue imagery for actual product communication.

Use

Accurate product imagery

Keep labels, proportions, pack sizes and colors faithful to the approved catalogue asset.

Compose

One focal point

Leave clean space for the headline. Use consistent image scale and a restrained background.

Describe

Meaningful alternatives

Write alt text for informative imagery. Decorative details get an empty alt attribute.

THE PRACTICAL DETAILS

Guidelines in practice

Proposed digital standards
01

Illustrations

Abstract editorial illustrations may support a concept. They cannot establish that an item is available.

02

Image exports

Use SVG for approved vector marks. Choose appropriately sized WebP / AVIF for raster web images and PNG when transparency matters.

03

Quality

Avoid compressed screenshots, altered product labels and busy collages that compete with the message.
